import os, pty, select, signal, subprocess, time
master, slave = pty.openpty()
cmd=['bash','scripts/run_idf.sh','-B','build/idf','-p','/dev/cu.usbserial-1130','monitor','--no-reset']
p=subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, start_new_session=True, close_fds=True)
os.close(slave); os.set_blocking(master, False)
buf=bytearray()
def collect(seconds):
    end=time.time()+seconds
    while time.time()<end:
        ready,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.2)
        if not ready: continue
        try: data=os.read(master,65536)
        except BlockingIOError: continue
        except OSError: break
        if not data: break
        buf.extend(data)
end=time.time()+15
while time.time()<end and b'esp-idf-monitor' not in buf and p.poll() is None:
    collect(0.5)
print('MONITOR_READY', b'esp-idf-monitor' in buf, 'PROCESS_ALIVE', p.poll() is None)
if p.poll() is None:
    os.write(master,b'status\r\n'); collect(4)
    os.write(master,b'sensors\r\n'); collect(7)
    os.write(master,b'sensors\r\n'); collect(3)
    os.write(master,b'\x1d'); collect(2)
if p.poll() is None:
    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    try: p.wait(timeout=3)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL); p.wait()
try: os.close(master)
except OSError: pass
out=buf.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
print('MONITOR_OUTPUT_BEGIN')
for line in out.splitlines():
    low=line.lower()
    if ('status firmware_sha=' in low or 'scd41 ' in low or 'rtc sampled=' in low or 'esp-rom:esp32s3' in low or 'rst:0x' in low or 'esp-idf-monitor' in low): print(line)
print('MONITOR_OUTPUT_END')
print('ROM_BOOT_MARKER', 'ESP-ROM:esp32s3' in out)
PY
